coordinates.S: count of semantic provider-membership authority sites changed in handwritten product source during the phase
coordinates.L: normalized additions plus deletions in handwritten product source required by the phase; generated SDK/OpenAPI artifacts, lockfiles and experiment harness files excluded
coordinates.C: count of demand-extraneous runtime capability obligations that must be truthfully implemented because the chosen treatment exposes/requires them
coordinates.A: count of distinct handwritten product-source authority sites whose logic must distinguish provider authentication policy in the phase
coordinates.Q: binary frozen-demand validity gate; 1 only if baseline, settings/auth, search normalization, tool exposure and required oracle behaviors pass

quality_gate.parallel_baseline: web_search and web_fetch both visible and functional
quality_gate.exa: web_search visible and functional; if web_fetch is visible it must also be functional
quality_gate.tavily: web_search visible and functional; if web_fetch is visible it must also be functional
